arxiv-2003-06869.title: L p L^{p} optimal prediction of the last zero of a spectrally negative Lévy process
arxiv-2003-06869.creator: Erik J. Baurdoux, José M. Pedraza
arxiv-2003-06869.description: Abstract Given a spectrally negative Lévy process X X drifting to infinity, (inspired on the early ideas of Shiryaev (2002)) we are interested in finding a stopping time that minimises the L p L^{p} distance ( p > 1 p>1 ) with g g , the last time X X is negative.

arxiv-2109-01975.title: James-Stein estimation of the first principal component I am indebted to Lisa Goldberg for conjecturing the result derived in this work.
arxiv-2109-01975.creator: Alex Shkolnik
arxiv-2109-01975.description: Abstract The Stein paradox has played an influential role in the field of high dimensional statistics. This result warns that the sample mean, classically regarded as the “usual estimator”, may be suboptimal in high dimensions. The development of the James-Stein estimator, that addresses this paradox, has by now inspired a large literature on the theme of “shrinkage” in statistics.

arxiv-2112-00473.title: An analytic study of the independent coherent errors in the surface code
arxiv-2112-00473.creator: Yuanchen Zhao, Dong E. Liu
arxiv-2112-00473.description: Abstract The realistic coherent errors could induce very different behaviors compared with their stochastic counterparts in the quantum error correction (QEC) and fault tolerant quantum computation. Their impacts are believed to be very subtle, more detrimental and hard to analyze compared to those ideal stochastic errors.

arxiv-2302-02913.title: Beyond Statistical Similarity: Rethinking Metrics for Deep Generative Models in Engineering Design
arxiv-2302-02913.creator: Lyle Regenwetter, Akash Srivastava, Dan Gutfreund, Faez Ahmed, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab regenwet@mit.edu, Akash.Srivastava@ibm.com,dgutfre@us.ibm.com, faez@mit.edu

Deep generative models such as Variational Autoencoders (VAEs), Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), Diffusion Models, and Transformers, have shown great promise in a variety of applications, including image and speech synthesis, natural language processing, and drug discovery.

arxiv-2406-00776.title: On spectrally optimal duals of frames generated by graphs
arxiv-2406-00776.creator: Deepshikha, Aniruddha Samanta
arxiv-2406-00776.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Deepshikha, Aniruddha Samanta. Recently, the concept of frames generated by graphs has been introduced in [ 12 ] . In this paper, we study spectrally optimal dual frames of frames generated by graphs. We show that if the frame is generated by a connected graph, then its canonical dual frame is the unique spectrally optimal dual frame for 1 1 -erasure and 2 2 -erasures.

arxiv-2409-19939.title: A database of upper limb surface electromyogram signals from demographically diverse individuals
arxiv-2409-19939.creator: Harshavardhana T. Gowda, Neha Kaul, Carlos Carrasco, Marcus Battraw, Safa Amer, Saniya Kotwal, Selena Lam, Zachary McNaughton, Ferdous Rahimi, Sana Shehabi, Jonathon Schofield, Lee M. Miller
arxiv-2409-19939.description: Abstract Upper limb based neuromuscular interfaces aim to provide a seamless way for humans to interact with technology. Among noninvasive interfaces, surface electromyogram (EMG) signals hold significant promise. However, their sensitivity to physiological and anatomical factors remains poorly understood, raising questions about how these factors influence gesture decoding across individuals or groups.

arxiv-2410-05723.title: On Principles and Representations for Extended Contextuality
arxiv-2410-05723.creator: Matt Jones (mcj@colorado.edu), University of Colorado
arxiv-2410-05723.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Matt Jones (mcj@colorado.edu), University of Colorado. There has been recent interest in whether the concept of quantum contextuality can be extended to systems with disturbance or signaling while retaining the essential properties of standard contextuality. Dzhafarov and Kujala [1] (arXiv:2302.11995) offer a provocative argument that the answer is always affirmative: If standard contextuality satisfies some principle that extended contextuality does not, then that principle must be ‘non-substantive’ in that it depends on a superficial choice of representation.

arxiv-2411-02943.title: Capturing research literature attitude towards Sustainable Development Goals: an LLM-based topic modeling approach
arxiv-2411-02943.creator: Francesco Invernici, Francesca Curati, Jelena Jakimov, Amirhossein Samavi, Anna Bernasconi
arxiv-2411-02943.description: Abstract The world is facing a multitude of challenges that hinder the development of human civilization and the well-being of humanity on the planet. The Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) were formulated by the United Nations in 2015 to address these global challenges by 2030. Natural language processing techniques can help uncover discussions on SDGs within research literature.

arxiv-2503-19796.title: Cross-correlation between soft X-rays and galaxies
arxiv-2503-19796.creator: Johan Comparat, Andrea Merloni, Gabriele Ponti, Soumya Shreeram, Yi Zhang, Thomas H. Reiprich, Ang Liu, Riccardo Seppi, Xiaoyuan Zhang, Nicolas Clerc, Andrina Nicola, Kirpal Nandra, Mara Salvato, Nicola Malavasi
arxiv-2503-19796.description: Abstract This paper presents the construction and validation of complete stellar mass-selected, volume-limited galaxy samples using the Legacy Survey (data release 10) galaxy catalogs, covering ∼ 16,800 \sim 16,800 deg 2 of extra-galactic sky and extending to redshifts of z < 0.35 z<0.35 . We used companion mock catalogs to ensure a controlled galaxy selection.

arxiv-2510-16977.title: Studying the Dust Distribution Around Accreting Black Holes with Reverberation Mapping Using PRIMA
arxiv-2510-16977.creator: Varoujan Gorjian, Michael W. Werner
arxiv-2510-16977.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Varoujan Gorjian, Michael W. Werner. Variability studies are a powerful tool for studying the structures of unresolved sources. One such type of variability study, called reverberation mapping (RM), established that the dominant source of infrared radiation from an active galactic nucleus (AGN) was from dust absorption and re-emission, which demonstrated that the optical brightening and fading of light from the accretion disk (AD) around a supermassive black hole was followed by a corresponding (delayed) variation at infrared (IR) wavelengths from the surrounding dust distribution.

pmc-10571368.title: Evaluation of the accuracy of cone-beam computed tomography image segmentation of isolated tooth roots based on the dynamic threshold method
pmc-10571368.creator: Sha Su, Yu-meng Liu, Li-ping Zhan, Si-yuan Gao, Cai He, Qing Zhang, Xiao-feng Huang
pmc-10571368.description: ObjectiveAccurate quantification of the root surface area (RSA) plays a decisive role in the advancement of periodontal, orthodontic, and restorative treatment modalities. In this study, we aimed to develop a dynamic threshold-based computer-aided system for segmentation and calculation of the RSA of isolated teeth on cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) and to assess the accuracy of the measured data.

pmc-11522978.title: Epidemiology of Inflammatory Bowel Disease across the Ages in the Era of Advanced Therapies
pmc-11522978.creator: Bénédicte Caron, Sailish Honap, Laurent Peyrin-Biroulet
pmc-11522978.description: Background and AimsThe incidence of inflammatory bowel diseases [IBD] has risen over the past decade to become a global issue. The objectives of this review were to describe the incidence and/or prevalence of IBD in the era of advanced therapies, and to describe the association between environmental risk factors and both pathogenesis and disease course across the ages.

pmc-11597202.title: Novel Thiazole-Fused [4,5-g] or [5,4-g]Quinazolin-8-ones and Their Quinazoline Analogues: Synthesis and Biological Evaluation
pmc-11597202.creator: Nathan Broudic, Alexandra Pacheco-Benichou, Cécile Corbière, Blandine Baratte, Thomas Robert, Stéphane Bach, Hélène Solhi, Rémy Le Guével, Corinne Fruit, Thierry Besson, Anna Carbone
pmc-11597202.description: Background/Objectives: In connection with previous work on V-shaped polycyclic thiazolo[5,4-f]quinazolin-9-one and [5,4-f]quinazoline derivatives that can modulate the activity of various kinases, the synthesis of straight thiazole-fused [4,5-g] or [5,4-g]quinazolin-8-ones and quinazoline derivatives hitherto undescribed was envisioned. Methods: An innovative protocol allowed to obtain the target structures.

pmc-12448336.title: Experimental exploration of artificial intelligence and ADAMS simulation technology in the teaching of vertical hoop upward throw in rhythmic gymnastics
pmc-12448336.creator: Qihong Ren, Zongjue Ma, Guojin Qin, Guojin Qin, Guojin Qin
pmc-12448336.description: Currently, rhythmic gymnastics teaching mainly focuses on traditional techniques and cannot break through issues such as blind spots in the coordination training between apparatus and body. In the academic field, research results are still dominated by single aspects such as new rules and event analysis.

pmc-12466282.title: Identifying clinical error patterns in nursing students’ CPR performance: a mixed-methods OSCE study
pmc-12466282.creator: Kheizaran Miri, Alireza Sardashti, Sajedeh Moradi, Arefeh Naseri, Amirhossein Mirzaei
pmc-12466282.description: BackgroundBasic Life Support (BLS) competency is critical for healthcare professionals, yet persistent performance gaps exist in training settings. This study aimed to identify error patterns in nursing students’ cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) performance during Objective Structured Clinical Examinations (OSCEs) and, through stakeholder insights, identify perceived challenges and suggest remediation strategies to improve learning outcomes.

pmc-12489076.title: Terahertz graphene-based tunable capacitance metamaterials with ultra-high amplitude modulation depth
pmc-12489076.creator: Zi-Jun Guo, Geng-Bo Wu
pmc-12489076.description: By combining substrate-side, phase-cancelling reflection with monolayer graphene reconfigured as nanoscale tunable lateral capacitors within metasurface unit cells, terahertz amplitude modulation exceeding 40 dB at around 2 THz with 30 MHz reconfiguration speed is demonstrated under solid-state, room-temperature conditions. The design provides a scalable and practical platform for high-speed, large-dynamic-range terahertz communications, real-time imaging, and programmable photonic circuits.

pmc-12588366.title: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Stroke Imaging in Emergency Settings: A Systematic Review
pmc-12588366.creator: Anas E Ahmed, Wassal F Aljohani, Liyan K Abu Rukbah, Shahad A Rajhi, Norah K Najmi, Mohammed K Zughlul, Abdulrahman M Alshammari, Sultan D Alotaibi, Taghreed H Almarhabi, Mohammed A Al-Amri, Sama B Rebh
pmc-12588366.description: Rapid and accurate interpretation of neuroimaging is critical in acute stroke, but variability among human readers and the urgency of clinical workflows pose major challenges. Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a promising adjunct in emergency stroke imaging, with the potential to enhance detection, scoring, and prognostication.

pmc-12944533.title: Relationship Between Family and Friend Support and Psychological Distress in Adolescents
pmc-12944533.creator: Margaret M. Fitzpatrick, Avery M. Anderson, Christopher Browning, Jodi L. Ford
pmc-12944533.description: Objective:This study examines the associations between family and friend support and depressive and anxiety symptoms among adolescents, considering potential sex differences.Methods:Secondary data from a longitudinal cohort study of 1,348 adolescents ages 11–17 were analyzed using descriptive statistics and multiple linear regression, controlling for relevant factors. Interaction terms between sex and support were created to examine moderation by sex.

pmc-13228179.title: Probing the Hall anomaly and electronic structure in kagome metal RbV3Sb5 under hydrostatic pressure
pmc-13228179.creator: Tsz Fung Poon, Zheyu Wang, Lingfei Wang, Ying Kit Tsui, Zikai Zhou, Wenyan Wang, Chun Wai Tsang, Alexandre Pourret, Gabriel Seyfarth, Georg Knebel, Swee K. Goh
pmc-13228179.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Kagome metals AV 3Sb 5 (A = K, Rb, Cs) are renowned for their intricate electronic band structures, providing a rich platform for investigating topological states and electronic correlations. Within the AV 3Sb 5 family, the detailed electronic structures of CsV 3Sb 5 and KV 3Sb 5 have been well established, both in their charge-density-wave (CDW) phase or in the pristine metallic phase. Yet, the electronic structure of RbV 3Sb 5 remains under-explored.

pmc-13350117.title: Joyce Structures from Quadratic Differentials on the Sphere
pmc-13350117.creator: Timothy Moy
pmc-13350117.description: Motivated by known examples of Joyce structures on spaces of meromorphic quadratic differentials, we consider the isomonodromic deformations of particular second-order linear ODEs with rational potential. We show the infinitesimal isomonodromic deformations are the kernel of a closed 2-form arising from the intersection pairing of an algebraic curve defined by the potential.
